title: Rich Girl Caretaker TV Anime Reveals July 4 Debut, Promo Video, More Cast
content: The official website for the anime adaptation of author Yusaku Sakaishi and illustrator Sakura Miwabe 's Rich Girl Caretaker ( Saijo no Osewa ) light novel series revealed the first promotional video, July 4 debut, opening theme information, and more cast on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'Isshiki-san wa Koi wo Shiritai.' Unveils Main Cast, Additional Staff, Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ayune Araragi 's Isshiki-san wa Koi wo Shiritai. ( Ms. Isshiki Wants to Know About Love ) manga unveiled the main cast, additional staff, and a teaser promotional video on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Eccentric Doctor of the Moon Flower Kingdom Gets Anime
content: The Eccentric Doctor of the Moon Flower Kingdom manga is getting an anime adaptation. Studio Elle is animating the series and a trailer was also released. The staff and cast were also announced; however, the release date is yet to be revealed.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu' Gets Second Season in Fall 2026
content: An official website opened for the second season of Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) anime series on Friday, revealing the returning cast, new staff, and a teaser visual (pictured).

title: Victoria of Many Faces Unveils New Trailer
content: Victoria of Many Faces anime unveiled a new trailer on Friday which features the ending theme song by KI_EN. The anime is slated to release this July. A visual and trailer were also revealed at AnimeJapan 2026 . Studio DEEN is animating with Nobukage Kimura as director.
author: Anime Corner
